_comment: The form a Ukrainian word is JUDGED in, shared by the two implementations
that must agree: tools/build_wordlist.py folds the shipped list this way,
and site/js/typo_hints.js folds what the user types the same way before
looking it up. Any divergence underlines correct words — the list would be
keyed one way and queried another.

cases.why: a sentence-initial capital is not a mistake
a shouted word is the same word
the project writes the typographic apostrophe
a straight apostrophe folds onto it
so does the modifier letter an editor may produce
the soft sign is a letter like any other
an apostrophe inside a transliteration survives
